title: Guidelines on outsourcing; reliance on others

paras.text: AMLA’s public consultations are open to all stakeholders with an interest in the EU’s anti money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) framework.

AMLA particularly welcomes input from obliged entities in both the financial and non-financial sectors, including specifically from smaller obliged entities, as the Guidelines are intended to apply across different sectors, business models and entity sizes. AMLA also welcomes contributions from service providers involved in outsourcing and other third-party arrangements, as their practical experience is important for assessing the operational feasibility of the proposed framework.

Stakeholders are invited to provide practical evidence on the proportionality and operational feasibility of the proposed framework, including proposal on simplification and proportionate approach for smaller and low risk entities and arrangements.

Public input on these draft Guidelines is essential to ensure that the expectations they contain are clear, proportionate and effective, and can be applied in practice by obliged entities across the financial and non-financial sectors.

These Draft Guidelines set out specific principles and rules obliged entities should apply when establishing outsourcing pursuant to Article 18 of the AMLR, reliance on customer due diligence performed by other obliged entities pursuant to Articles 48 and 49 of the AMLR, and address other third-party arrangements under the anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing and non-implementation and evasion of targeted financial sanctions (AML/CFT/TFS) framework as AMLA’s own-initiative guidelines pursuant to Article 54(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1620.

These Draft Guidelines are addressed to obliged entities as defined in Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 and supervisors as defined in Article 2(1) point (45) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 responsible for supervising these obliged entities compliance with their AML/CFT/TFS obligations.
A Public Hearing on the draft Guidelines is planned for Wednesday, 10 February 2027, from 14:00 to 16:00 CET. Please click the button below to register.

AMLA ensures the protection of personal data while consulting citizens and stakeholders online. Further information can be found in the Record of Processing Activity and the Privacy Statement for this consultation.
